notes: Audio is streamed from provider URLs; no MP3 files are included in the site package.
All 12 listed reciters are represented as Hafs an Asim and provide 114 surah URLs each.
Ibrahim Al-Akdar and Ahmad ibn Ali Al-Ajmy were added from MP3Quran API catalog data.
Local word-timing archives are available for the original 10 reciters only.
Only canonical primary verse timing rows are used for synchronization.
Raad Al-Kurdi timing coverage excludes six verses; his audio chapter URLs are still listed.
Mushaf page layouts are downloaded from the cited page-layout source on demand and cached by the browser; browser storage may still be cleared or evicted.
